name: Blinn-Phong Toon Shading
definition: Toon-shaded variant of Blinn-Phong that posterizes diffuse lighting and harshly cuts specular reflections.
summary: Blinn-Phong Toon Shading is a non-photorealistic model that applies aggressive quantization to Blinn-Phong lighting, replacing smooth gradients with discrete color bands while retaining the half-vector specular structure.
